description: This Java class defines a final, immutable class OutboundSignalToExternalMessage that converts an OutboundSignal.Mapped object into an ExternalMessage, applying optional header mappings with placeholder resolution. It is part of a messaging service within an Eclipse-based project, specifically for handling communication and message transformation.

classes.name: OutboundSignalToExternalMessage
classes.description: An immutable class that converts an OutboundSignal.Mapped into an ExternalMessage, applying header mappings and resolving placeholders.

methods.description: Creates a new instance of OutboundSignalToExternalMessage with optional header mapping.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Generates and returns an ExternalMessage, applying header mappings if configured.

methods.description: Maps headers using the headerMapping, resolving placeholders where necessary.
